core_problem_solved: To provide a host of helper utilities for the `java.lang` API, adding functionality for common operations that are missing or cumbersome in the standard Java library, such as null-safe string manipulation.
era_and_niche: A foundational and nearly ubiquitous utility library in the Java ecosystem throughout the 2000s, providing essential helpers for countless applications.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is a **legacy library**. It was officially superseded by a major new version, **`org.apache.commons:commons-lang3`**. The new version uses a different package name (`org.apache.commons.lang3`) to allow side-by-side usage and is the actively maintained and recommended version for all projects.
